keyFindings.description: The PR adds the deployment's Dispatch issue keys and dispatch:// links to files of a public repository: the three '(until INFRA-572)' job names, the six job comments naming INFRA-572 and INFRA-573, the architecture sentence, and the fragment's file name and Issue field. The INFRA controller's ruling (relayed by the INFRA-148 architect at 2026-10-28T10:05Z, under 'Stop new leaks only', INFRA-472) forbids any added line outside .legion/ naming one. Fix: describe the condition instead ('until production runs Postgres 18'), rename the fragment by `changie new --custom Issue=pr2364` (file pr2364-Changed-<time>.yaml, Issue: pr2364). Check: `jj diff --git --from <merge base> --to <head> '~glob:".legion/**"'` has no added line or path matching INFRA-[0-9]+, LEGION-[0-9]+ or dispatch://. Retro cannot carry this: it may touch only docs/solutions and .legion/.

The fold files packages/envoy fragments under legion-envoy-v releases (changelog-fold.yaml:65-68), while the default ships on envoy-infra-v tags, so 'moves to this release or later' will sit under a listener version. Name the release explicitly, e.g. 'the first envoy-infra release after v2.9.1'.
